programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: Are the swarms of drones seen over New Jersey friend or foe? A strange green creature is found in Taiwan. Could it be an alien? Why are hundreds of fish spinning themselves to death? programme.title: The Proof Is Out There

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: Could a pulsating light seen over Cuba be a UFO? A creature is seen swimming in a New York lake. Is there an American "Loch Ness" Monster? programme.title: The UnXplained
